free_tier.stated: No free allowance is stated on the pricing page read 2026-11-18: access is sold as daily, weekly and monthly USD packages, e.g. a 1-day 50U plan at $1.59/day.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: an OpenAI-compatible key issued by the gateway after a package is bought
chaining: the prepaid package is the scarce link; no standing free tier is published

limits.value: paid packages with USD limits, e.g. $1.59/day for a 50U 1-day plan

identity_cost.detail: payment via Alipay, Crypto or Stripe is needed to buy a package

reliability_note: packages are time-limited and expire after their stated validity (24 hours, 7 days or 30 days)

evidence.proved: access is sold as timed USD quota packages with no free tier
